measurement_scope: Separate native-profiler windows, each containing only one complete original query execution; not formal runtime confirmation samples.

counter_meanings.readRecord: DatabaseStats lookup counter incremented by LocalDatabase.lookupByRID and lookupByKey, including cached record lookups; not edge visits or Neo4j DB Hits.
counter_meanings.iterateType: Number of database type-iteration operations, not number of yielded records.
counter_meanings.scanType: Number of database type-scan operations, not number of yielded records.

checks.query: MATCH (n:ScorRoot {uid: 1}) RETURN n.uid AS `uid`, n.id AS `id`, n.key AS `key`, n.expected_count AS `expected_count`
MATCH (n:ScorRoot {uid: 1, id: 1, key: 1, expected_count: 400000}) RETURN count(n) AS `count`
MATCH (n:ScorTarget {mark: true, key: 1}) RETURN count(n) AS `count`
MATCH (u:ScorRoot {id: 1, key: 1})-[r:GSP_SC_HIGH]->(v:ScorTarget {mark: true, key: 1}) RETURN count(r) AS `count`
MATCH (u:ScorRoot {id: 1, key: 1})-[r:GSP_SC_REF]->(v:ScorTarget {mark: true, key: 1}) RETURN count(r) AS `count`

checks.query: MATCH (n:GspAnchor {uid: 1}) RETURN n.uid AS `uid`, n.keep AS `keep`
MATCH (n:GspAnchor {uid: 1, keep: false}) RETURN count(n) AS `count`
MATCH (n:GspAnchor {uid: 2}) RETURN n.uid AS `uid`, n.keep AS `keep`
MATCH (n:GspAnchor {uid: 2, keep: true}) RETURN count(n) AS `count`
MATCH (n:GspLeaf {uid: 3}) RETURN n.uid AS `uid`, n.mark AS `mark`
MATCH (n:GspLeaf {uid: 3, mark: true}) RETURN count(n) AS `count`
MATCH (u:GspAnchor)-[:GSP_REFERENCE]->(v:GspLeaf) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (u)-[:GSP_EXPAND]->(v) } RETURN count(v) AS `count`
MATCH (u:GspAnchor)-[:GSP_EXPAND]->(v:GspLeaf) WHERE coalesce(u.keep, false) = true AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (u)-[:GSP_REFERENCE]->(v) } RETURN count(v) AS `count`
